description: This file defines a Java class 'Now' implementing functionality for handling <now>, <now-date-to-env>, and <now-timestamp> elements in a mini-language processing context within the OFBiz framework. It includes validation, conversion, and runtime execution logic related to date/time handling.

classes.name: Now
classes.description: Implements the <now>, <now-date-to-env>, and <now-timestamp> elements, providing functionality for date/time insertion and conversion within the mini-language processing framework.

methods.description: Executes the operation by inserting the current system time, converted to the specified type, into the environment map.

methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Now element, including its attributes.
